title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S5 E1 — The Gang Investigators
From small towns to big cities, virtually every jail and prison in the United States deals with a gang problem; for some, suppressing gangs is a daily challenge that comes with life or death consequences.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S5 E3 — A Brotherhood of Gangs
How gangs are managed in the jail system; how family relationships affect the jail experience.

title: Lockup: Tulsa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Beat Down
A convicted sex offender becomes the victim of a brutal assault that leaves him unconscious and in the hospital; his assailants say the attack was warranted, but what they don't know might bring regret.

title: Lockup: Louisville: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Bam Bam
One inmate's stress prompts an emergency response; a repeat offender is charged with beating her mother, and now must rely on her own daughter for support; an inmate known for his brawn decides to focus on his brain.

title: Lockup: Louisville: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E7 — Tangled Web
Police take a young man into custody following the murder of a 15-year-old boy in his Louisville, Ky., home; the jail finds itself with a multitude of related high-profile cases.

title: Lockup: Pendleton: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Inside Pendleton Juvenile
The inmates at Indiana's Pendleton Juvenile Correctional Facility aren't sentenced in terms of years; they get out when they achieve certain goals, no matter how long that takes.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S3 E1 — Doomed Decisions
Producers take the time to get to know dozens of inmates, following the action and watching the story unfold in from of their eyes.

title: Lockup Special Investigation
description:
S1 E1 — Lake County Juvenile Justice: Kenneth, Kentrell, Devon
For some kids, the revolving door of lockup seems to snag one generation after the next; 17-year-old Kenneth and 14-year-old Kentrell have 10 brothers and sisters, a father in prison and a mother with a criminal record for public nuisance.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S4 E4 — Jailhouse Blues
Before any inmate sees the inside of a prison, he has most likely first seen the inside of a jail; nothing about jail is for the faint of heart; for some, jail is the ultimate limbo between freedom and a life behind bars or even worse.

S1 E2 — 352,955 Days to Life
